matches.rationale: No finding addresses the fabricated fairness/safety citations [7, 37] in the Introduction. The reference-fabrication findings (pred_id 11, 12) point to different references and locations.
Finding pred_id 1 identifies a contradiction in Section 4 regarding whether LayerCast upcasts or keeps BF16, which is the same method-logic consistency issue described in the ground truth.
Finding pred_id 3 detects a text-table mismatch about LayerCast fluctuations, not the unrealistic perfect-reproducibility claim itself. The underlying issues differ.
Ground truth concerns FP32 OOM for 2 L40S GPUs; finding pred_id 6 addresses a different claim about 4-GPU BS32 unavailability. They are distinct errors.
No finding challenges the abstract's statement that non-associative floating-point arithmetic is the root cause, ignoring other sources.
The Conclusion overstatement of LayerCast determinism is not mentioned by any finding.
No finding addresses the omission of environmental/energy cost discussion.
No finding captures the contradiction between the seed-determinism assumption in the introduction and the empirical nondeterminism shown later.
The ground truth describes cherry-picking that hides catastrophic BF16 failure modes. No finding identifies this selective reporting.
The oversimplified attribution of variance to mantissa bits is not identified by any finding; pred_id 13 addresses a separate BF16-range misstatement.
Finding pred_id 8 points out the lack of motivation for sample sizes (n=4, 16) and absence of confidence intervals in the Pass@1 experiments, matching the experimental design flaw.
No finding detects the conceptual confusion about seed determinism and numerical precision in the Preliminaries.
The Introduction's overstated impact claim ('poses a serious problem') is not identified as rhetorical manipulation by any finding.
The specific FP32 variance exceeding BF16 in Table 5 (AIME'24, n=64) is not flagged by any finding.
No finding discusses the absence of the limitations paragraph that restricts the scope of experimental findings.
The exaggerated Figure 1 caption (480 vs. 960) is not mentioned in any finding.
Finding pred_id 7 identifies that non-identical random seeds were used in greedy decoding, undermining the claimed isolation of precision-induced variance, exactly as in the ground truth.
No finding addresses the overstatement in Related Work that no prior studies systematically analyzed numerical precision effects.
Pred_id 13 discusses a BF16 range error, not the contradiction between similar rounding errors for BF16/FP16 and their different output variance.
No finding points out the missing LayerCast implementation details (e.g., normalization layers, non-linear layers) that hinder reproducibility.
